scope: Current committed implementation: logical Python modules, a local durable summary registry, simulated bank fixtures and external calls; not separately deployed services.
review_method: Image-capable review of all four screenshots produced by the artifact-bound visual-check command.
observations: All eleven nodes and all three context cards fit in both themes at the two screenshot sizes.
The browser path and branches to the simulated bank, persistent registry, rate API, report builder and PDF parser remain distinct.
Labels avoid node boxes, no route crossings are visible, and the store is clearly labelled data/issued.json.
The larger composition uses the available height without a conspicuous empty lower band.

manual_interaction_tests.reason: No custom interaction was requested. Search, focus, route tracing and guided-view controls are supplied by the bundled viewer; this review does not claim that each control was exercised.

limits: Code evidence establishes the checked commit's implementation, not a running deployment or a successful external API response.
The automated browser receipt intentionally retains visualReview pending; this separate record captures the subsequent image review.
revision_update: Repository source links were repinned to the current history. Topology, layout and authored content are unchanged.

publication.note: Absolute local path fields were made repository-relative for publication. Artifact and specification hashes, byte counts, source revision and validation outcomes are unchanged.
